Source Monster

Monster: Coral Pukei-Pukei | CR: 10 | Tier: 2

Compatible Slots: Armor, Weapon

Weapon Effect

When you cast a spell that deals acid damage, add half of your proficiency bonus to that damage.

Armor Effect

While wearing this armor, you have a swimming speed equal to your walking speed, and you can hold your breath underwater for twice as long as normal.

Tags: mechanic:spell-buff:damage, damage:acid, type:offensive, type:utility, mechanic:movement

effects.description: Swimming speed 30 ft (approximately equal to walking speed) and extended breath underwater (passive).
